audit_label: R817 MM2 outdoor encounter grids audit
audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
audit_comment: THE MM2 OUTDOOR ENCOUNTER TABLES WALK - the 36 terrain grids (print pp. 140-141+, the 6 main areas x 6 terrains), every die row 2-20 pinned as the three-cell grid (die, source, special). THE SCHEMA: the outdoor grids print no source and no number-encountered columns (the dungeon grids carry both), so the source cells are EDITORIAL - 1 MM1 / 2 MM2 / 3 FF / 0 none - derived from the print own index (the M/F/bare page refs) and the registry provenance (the lua headers); the special cells 1 the Character Party row (the DMG character subtable), 2 the Castle/Fortress structure row, 3 the Patrol men row. THE SETTLED READS (the two word layers, the print index, the registry provenance and the 1eonline FF roster the voices): the Giant, Mountain cell is the print own index pointer - FF p.42, the Lambeosaurus parenthetical - no registry def; the Tween cells are the index Luck Changer, FF p.91; the Dragon, Earth cells the index Li Lung (the FF oriental earth dragon), FF p.28; the Troll, Ice cells the index FF p.90 pointer; the Volt, Vortex, Ettercap, Poltergeist, Rothe, Xvart, Norker, Dakon, Penanggalan, Revenant, Sandman, Scarecrow, Huecuva, Shadow Demon, Blood Hawk, Hoar Fox, Jermlaine, Killmoulis, Kelpie, Kenku, Khargra, Meazel, Ogrillon, Osquip, Quaggoth, Snyad, Tiger Fly, Witherweed, Caterwaul, Coffer Corpse, Crypt Thing, Denzelian, Devil Dog, Disenchanter, Dune Stalker, Firedrake, Firenewt, Forlarren, Gambado, Grabman (the FF Crabman, the print own misspelling) and Aarakocra, Algoid, Assassin Bug, Cifal, Clubnek all FF per the index F-refs and the 1eonline FF roster - the registry carries no FF defs, the rows ride keyless. THE MEN ROWS: the Men, Nomad cells key dervish (the index: Nomad (Dervish)); the Man, Patrol rows (15 cells) cite no stat block anywhere in the MM1/MM2/FF prints - they ride the men row class, keyless. THE EDITORIAL PICKS (all flagged here, the or-row first-creature convention the R816 rule): the Aspis cell aspis_drone, the Formian cell formian_worker, the Grue Elemental cell chaggrin (the first variant of the MM2 p.72 elemental grue entry), the plain Camel cells camel_dromedary, the Bee Giant Honey cells bee_worker, the Treant cell the mature treant, the Bat cells bat_ordinary/bat_mobat, the plain Vulture cells vulture_ordinary, the Demon Type I cell the vrock, the plain Snake cells the MM1 constrictor/poisonous keys (the registry MM2 snake_constrictor/snake_poisonous stay with the MM2 S-walk), the Dwarf Hill and Dwarf Mountain cells the dwarf def, the Volt or Ghoul and Quaggoth or Deadly White Pudding rows keyless (the first creature FF). THE SCAN NOTES: the scan-B Worker cells are Norker misreads (the R816 lesson); the coldSnake cells read Poisonous (white-furred) - the MM1 poisonous snake arctic parenthetical, keyed poisonous_snake. THE FLAGGED CELLS: the Pterodactyl, Small cell (tropical wilderness mountains die 10) - no index entry, no MM1/MM2/FF body def survives in the registry sources - rides keyless for the physical copy; the Lammasu, Greater cells (temperate civilized plains die 2, tropical civilized hills die 20) point at a real MM2 stat block, LAMMASU GREATER p. 79 (between the kraken and the land lamprey) that the R808 LMN walk never promoted - src MM2, keyless pending that promotion round. THE PARTY ROWS: 17 Character Party rows on 16 grids; the cold civilized desert grid alone carries two (dies 7 and 14); the cold wilderness hills grid the one wilderness grid with a party row.
